## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## Problem Statement / Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including any UI changes, settings, or CLI flags.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Checklist
- [ ] Confirmed the feature adheres to project boundaries (offline-first, no camera credentials, no external cloud dependencies, loopback-only).
- [ ] Confirmed no sensitive or proprietary data is included.
